gt_future_endpoint_displacement_diagnost.note: post-hoc only; not used in score, adjustment, threshold, or decision

motion_adjustment_source: internal_val frozen coefficients; no refit on holdout

ensemble_risk_coverage_global.ranking_direction: ascending score; retain lowest values first
ensemble_risk_coverage_global.motion_only_direction: low observed motion is treated as lower risk and retained first
ensemble_risk_coverage_global.oracle_reference: ranks by true ADE; upper bound only, not deployable
ensemble_risk_coverage_global.coverage_sample_rule: floor(N*coverage), with all samples at 100% and at least one otherwise

ensemble_risk_coverage_motion_stratified.strata: internal_val motion deciles frozen before holdout

within_motion_permutation.method: permute raw u_mean independently within each validation-defined motion decile; fixed motion, ADE, and FDE
within_motion_permutation.lower_tail_p_interpretation: small values mean observed stratified risk is lower than the within-motion random ranking

decision.rule: REPLICATED requires at least 4/5 frozen criteria and adjusted video-cluster rho CI lower bound > 0; PARTIAL for 2-3 criteria or insufficient cluster certainty; NOT_REPLICATED for <=1 criterion.
